    probe('result_shape', result.shape[0])
    probe('has_nan', float(np.isnan(result).any()))
    probe('result_values', result.ravel()[:5])
except ValueError as e:
    probe('exception_raised', 1.0)
    probe('exception_type', 0.0)
except Exception as e:
    probe('exception_type', 2.0)
    probe('exception_raised', 1.0)
